mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_delivery (id, notification_id, channel, status, provider_message_id, retry_count, last_error, sent_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{notificationId}, #{channel}, 'PENDING', NULL, 0, NULL, NULL, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT id, notification_id, channel, status, provider_message_id, retry_count, last_error, sent_at, created_at, updated_at FROM notification_delivery WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId} AND channel = #{channel}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_delivery SET status = 'SENT', provider_message_id = #{providerMessageId}, sent_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId} AND channel = #{channel} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE notification_delivery SET
status = 'FAILED' status = 'SKIPPED' , last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId} AND channel = #{channel} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE notification_delivery SET retry_count = #{retryCount}, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId} AND channel = #{channel} AND status = 'PENDING'
